snippet.title: Crash Team Racing (2010) Gameplay
snippet.description:
Gameplay footage from Crash Team Racing (2010).

If you'd like to try a similar alternative, Crash Bandicoot Nitro Kart 2 for iOS shares some features and elements. You can support the series by getting it here: https://itunes.apple.com/en/app/crash-bandicoot-nitro-kart-2/id373849969?mt=8
